================================================================================================
  MULTI-COMMUNITY BENCHMARK — measured, on this machine, against the local fixture web
================================================================================================
  4 logical CPUs, 15.7 GB RAM
  16 identical communities per run
  fixture latency 150 ms per request — a real server's waiting, which is what parallel communities overlap

  Workers  Peak     Wall  Speed-up  Effic.  Per hour  Per w-min  CPU mean  CPU peak   RAM peak   Spread
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        1     1   441.5s     1.00x   100%       130       2.17        5%       27%       812M     7.4s
        4     4   142.5s     3.10x    77%       404       1.68       13%       97%      1028M    28.1s
        8     8   109.5s     4.03x    50%       526       1.10       19%      100%      1350M    46.9s
       16     9   103.9s     4.25x    27%       554       0.58       27%      100%      1455M    41.8s

  FITTED SCALABILITY  speed-up(N) = N / (1 + σ(N-1) + κN(N-1))
    σ (contention, cannot overlap) ... 0.0850
    κ (interference between workers)  0.006290
    residual sum of squares ......... 0.0148
    predicted best worker count ..... 12 (4.3x)

  Paste into config/config.yaml under `orchestrator:` to make the
  estimate the researcher sees reflect this machine:
    scalability_contention: 0.0850
    scalability_coherency: 0.006290

  Shortest wall-clock: 16 workers (103.9s)
  Best per worker-minute: 1 workers (2.17 completions/worker-minute)
  These differ: past the second number, extra workers shorten the
  run by less than they cost. That is the point the governor
  detects at run time and stops growing at.

  With latency injected, this is what the parallelism is FOR:
  sixteen communities waiting on sixteen different servers, which
  is the case the whole design exists to exploit.
  Either way, process startup, database contention, the scheduler and
  the host broker are all the production ones.
================================================================================================
